title: Fixes, unresolved issues and owner confidence
summary: This topic mixes comments about unresolved repairs, dissatisfaction, and confidence in the car, with many fragments too brief or context-poor to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: One positive review notes a generally faultless ownership experience despite some reservations about the new dashboard layout.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe outright dissatisfaction, unresolved or lengthy fixes, and a willingness to discourage others from the brand.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention items needing to be fixed, radio trouble, a nuisance fixed headrest, and uncertainty or praise without enough context to classify reliably.

limitations: The cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including repair status, product features, accident repair delays, and general confidence in the vehicle or brand.
Most fragments are undetermined and several are very short, so the available examples are insufficient for a more precise thematic summary.
The single positive example includes a reservation, while clearly positive wording such as 'completely faultless' appears in an undetermined fragment and cannot be reassigned.
